label: Яма
description: A 10-sentence usage card for яма (pit, hole).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Яма' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Глубокая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'была' agrees in the past tense.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Яму' is the feminine accusative direct object. 'Большую' agrees in the accusative, and 'выкопали' is the past-tense plural verb.
Strategic focus: Genitive under negation. After the negated verb 'не объехала' the object shifts to the genitive 'ямы'. 'Машина' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В яму' uses the accusative 'яму' after 'в' to express motion into the hole. 'Упал' shows the fall.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Ямы' is the genitive linked to 'дне', the bottom of the pit. 'Вода' is the nominative subject standing there.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В яме' uses the prepositional form 'яме' after 'в' to locate where the cat hid. 'Напуганный кот' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative object with instrumental means. 'Яму' is the accusative object, and 'землёй' is the instrumental naming what filled it. A clear two-case sentence.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Много' governs the genitive plural 'ям'. 'Глубоких' agrees, and 'на поле' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Ямы' is the feminine nominative plural subject. 'Новые' agrees in the plural, and 'появились' marks their appearance.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Ямы' is the inanimate accusative plural, matching the nominative plural. 'Стороной' is an instrumental adverb meaning 'around the side'.
